# The 20 s per-test hang budget kills xdist workers on every CI run

## Symptom (pristine `origin/main` @ 6a5c88027c5)

The gating `pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` leg — the only one adding `--cov=rebar` — failed
every run with ~11-13 worker deaths (`[gwN] node down`, `worker 'gwN' crashed`) on a drifting
set of whole-tree-scanning tests, with ZERO `Failed: Timeout` lines (runs 32583448507,
32585303586). The integration tier showed the same deaths and then hung to the ~60-min job
cap. Main was red for every change.

## Root cause — CONFIRMED (full evidence trail in this ticket's comments)

**Part 1 — the budget sat inside the band of legitimate costs.** Commit `6a5c88027c5`
(story 73b8-2d79-3046-44ce) cut the budget 300 s -> 20 s in `pyproject.toml` and both
`_build-and-test.yml` lanes. The parent commit's own green run (32581500417, `--timeout=300`,
16182 passed, zero crashes) measures ~14 tests at 18.7-29.93 s of `call` time on this leg.
`timeout_func_only` cannot help: the body IS the whole-tree scan.

**Part 2 — `timeout_method = "thread"` expires a test via `os._exit(1)`** (pytest_timeout.py:542),
killing the xdist worker; only the `signal` method reports `Failed: Timeout`. So an expiry can
NEVER surface as a timeout verdict — zero `Failed: Timeout` is a prediction of the mechanism.
Reproduced locally with a 3-armed discriminating experiment (see comments).

**Part 3 — a config-only restore cannot pass its own gate.** Change 2115 PS1 carried the
restore and FAILED its own Verified run 32587991195 with the same signature: the Verified
gate executes the workflow files from TRUSTED MAIN (headSha 6a5c88027c5; job 97067339850 log
line 989 still ran `--timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread`), and pytest-timeout precedence is
CLI > INI, so main's stale flag overrode the patchset's ini. The fix was structurally
unexercisable by its own gate run.

## Fix — AS LANDED (change 2115, merged `a42a9d8d494`)

Restores the 300 s value bug 89d5-61da-b621-47f8 established ("dwarfs the slowest legitimate
test") while keeping story 73b8's real improvement (the budget lives in
`[tool.pytest.ini_options]` so bare local `pytest` runs are guarded too):

1. `pyproject.toml` — `timeout = 300`; the comment cites the measured 29.93 s worst case,
   the 2x headroom rationale, and why `thread` is kept (`signal` is unsafe under xdist).
2. `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` — both shared-tier lanes carry
   `--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread`, matching the ini.
3. `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py` — budget contract updated to 300; the marker-override
   arm restructured OUT-OF-PROCESS with a small generated budget so it completes in seconds
   instead of sleeping past the real budget; a new arm proves an unmarked over-budget test is
   still killed by the ini alone (the hang guard has teeth).
4. `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` (NEW) — the headroom invariant: budget >= 2x
   the measured 29.93 s worst legitimate body AND still a real guard (<= 600 s, thread method).
5. `docs/local-dev-env.md` — documents the 300 s budget and its derivation.

**Landing path:** because Part 3 makes the change's own Verified run structurally unable to
exercise the fix, the operator cast `Verified +1` manually and submitted (2026-08-22 18:16),
with post-merge gate runs as the empirical proof. Merged-main runs 32590300224 / 32590289712
at `a42a9d8d494`: ALL pytest legs success — including ubuntu py3.13 — with zero worker
crashes, and the integration tier completed within budget. Subsequent changes `037d4da8373`
and `53eaea07aa2` landed through the normal gate: main is unblocked.

**Prevention split out (discovered_from this ticket):** 5a30-d423-b1f5-4e33 carries the
conftest marker-floor mechanism (MARKER > CLI > INI precedence, verified empirically) that
would make the repo's ini authoritative over any future stale trusted-main `--timeout` flag —
the class defect behind Part 3. The loadgroup worker-death hang (secondary symptom) was fixed
on main by `53eaea07aa2` (ticket 8a4f-f0f4-ed92-4c70, `--max-worker-restart=0`); the
follow-up bug cac1-6391-7944-470e filed from this investigation closed as its duplicate.
`timeout_func_only = true` deliberately KEPT (follow-up 797b-bbc4-01cf-42d5 owns the
fixture-phase gap).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `[tool.pytest.ini_options].timeout` is 300 with a comment citing the measured worst
      case; verified by `test_timeout_budget.py::test_the_configured_budget_is_the_measured_one`.
- [x] Budget >= 2x the measured 29.93 s worst legitimate body and <= 600 s with thread method;
      verified by `test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` (both tests).
- [x] Both `_build-and-test.yml` shared-tier lanes carry the ini budget (`--timeout=300
      --timeout-method=thread`); verified by
      `test_the_shared_tier_lanes_carry_the_ini_timeout_budget`.
- [x] Every CI pytest lane has a per-test hang guard; verified by
      `test_every_ci_pytest_lane_has_a_per_test_hang_guard`.
- [x] `@pytest.mark.timeout(N, func_only=True)` still overrides the ini, proven in seconds
      (out-of-process, small generated budget); verified by
      `test_a_marked_test_may_outrun_the_ini_budget`.
- [x] An unmarked over-budget test is still killed by the ini alone; verified by
      `test_an_unmarked_over_budget_test_is_killed_by_the_ini_alone`.
- [x] Merged main is green: post-merge runs 32590300224 / 32590289712 at `a42a9d8d494` show
      all pytest legs success, zero `worker crashed` / `node down`, integration tier
      completing within its budget (evidence cited in comments).
- [x] Prevention and secondary-symptom work recorded: 5a30-d423-b1f5-4e33 (ini-floor
      hardening, discovered_from) filed; cac1-6391-7944-470e closed as duplicate of
      8a4f-f0f4-ed92-4c70 (landed `--max-worker-restart=0`).

## Verification

    pytest tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py \
           tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q
